speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth. To narrow down the cause, can you tell me if the mother had any infections during pregnancy or if there were any complications during delivery? Also, has the baby been feeding well since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of chorioamnionitis, low birth weight, and early onset seizures, early-onset neonatal sepsis is the most likely diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Early-onset neonatal sepsis
